🚀 ctxport | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To facilitate the seamless transfer and organization of AI-generated conversations and knowledge across different AI platforms, editors, and documentation tools by converting them into a clean Markdown format.
✨ Key Features: • One-click copying of AI conversations • Outputs clean, structured Markdown
📖 Summary: CtxPort is a browser extension that allows users to easily copy AI conversations from platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini into clean, structured Markdown format. It prioritizes local processing and privacy, enabling seamless transfer of AI-generated knowledge between different tools and workflows.
